'''Bobby Wilson''' is a mathematician and associate professor at the University of Washington.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bobby Wilson {{!}} Department of Mathematics {{!}} University of Washington|url=https://math.washington.edu/people/bobby-wilson|access-date=2026-01-02|website=math.washington.edu}}</ref>

==Professional career and research==
Wilson obtained his Ph.D. at the [[University of Chicago]] in 2015 under the supervision of [[Wilhelm Schlag]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=198143}}</ref> He was an undergraduate at [[Morehouse College]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Morehouse College {{!}} Archived Events|url=https://www.morehouse.edu/academics/math/newseventsarchive.html|access-date=2020-06-30|website=www.morehouse.edu}}</ref> He was a CLE Moore Instructor at MIT 2015–2018.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=MIT Profile|url=https://community.chronicle.com/people/912727-bobby-wilson/profile|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200701070635/https://community.chronicle.com/people/912727-bobby-wilson/profile |archive-date=2020-07-01 |access-date=2020-06-30|website=community.chronicle.com}}</ref> He was twice an [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] Postdoctoral Fellow (New Challenges in PDE and Harmonic Analysis) and will participate in the MSRI program Mathematical problems in fluid dynamics in 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=MSRI Profile|url=https://www.msri.org/people/19612|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141102223320/http://www.msri.org:80/people/19612 |archive-date=2014-11-02 |access-date=|website=}}</ref> His research "has been primarily concerned with questions concerning structure theory of measures and the dynamics of dispersive evolutionary equations."<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=2020 Inaugural Class of Karen EDGE Fellows|url=https://www.edgeforwomen.org/2020-inaugural-class-of-karen-edge-fellows/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200617111731/https://www.edgeforwomen.org/2020-inaugural-class-of-karen-edge-fellows/ |archive-date=2020-06-17 |access-date=|website=}}</ref>

==Honors==
In 2020, he was awarded one of three [[EDGE Foundation|Karen EDGE Fellowships]]<ref name=":0" /> and he was profiled in [[Mathematically Gifted & Black]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bobby Wilson|url=https://mathematicallygiftedandblack.com/honorees/bobby-wilson/|access-date=2020-06-30|website=Mathematically Gifted & Black|language=en-US}}</ref>
